channel.title: News Bot — TechCrunch AI (Tech & AI)
channel.description: RSS-Feed für die Quelle 'TechCrunch AI' (Kategorie: Tech & AI).

item.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
item.description: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

item.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
item.description: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

item.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
item.description: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

item.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
item.description: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

item.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
item.description: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.

item.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
item.description: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

item.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
item.description: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

item.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
item.description: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

item.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
item.description: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.
